newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fiskaragung revises up '97 net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Fiskaragung revises up '97 net forecast.

text.p: Indonesian salt producer PT Fiskaragung Perkasa said on Tuesday it had revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 144 billion rupiah from its previous 104.1 billion rupiah.

"We revised up our forecast to 144 billion rupiah, or about 15 percent from out Initial Public Offering target of about 104.1 billion rupiah," Bob Butar Butar, Fiskaragung's investor relations told Reuters.
He said further details of the company's forecast and background information would be made available in the statement which was scheduled to be released later on Tuesday.
